fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact hard-function input-JVP MSE

controls.step_zero_parent: zero codebook, tangent U, and output offsets
controls.hard_value_only: zero tangent U and output offsets; exact JVP must equal the parent JVP
controls.global_code_coordinates: replace layer-private router biases and code gains by their across-layer means
controls.initial_random_router: replace fitted P and Q by their exact deterministic initializations
controls.single_bank_only: retain only bank zero's selected code contribution
controls.dense_teacher: exact terminal teacher output and input-JVP identity
